title: Correct vertical displacement
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the vertical displacement from the brick count and thickness (20 m).

title: Correct flight time
description: Essential: Student correctly applies the free-fall time formula (t = sqrt(2y/g)) to obtain t = 2 s.

title: Correct vertical velocity at A
description: Important: Student correctly calculates the vertical velocity at impact using v_y = gt (20 m/s).

title: Correct velocity decomposition
description: Important: Student correctly relates horizontal and vertical velocities at point A using the slope angle (v_0 = v_y * tan(37°)).

title: Correct horizontal velocity
description: Essential: Student correctly computes the final horizontal velocity v_0 = 15 m/s.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall: Student fails to convert brick thickness from cm to m, leading to incorrect displacement.

title: Incorrect angle relation
description: Pitfall: Student misapplies the trigonometric relation (e.g., uses sin or cos instead of tan) for velocity decomposition.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns signs to velocity components or misinterprets 'hits exactly vertically'.
